answer: A sybil-resistant economy can gate entry through a narrow inlet: each new agent must post a bond and wait out a slow admission queue, so spawning thousands of fake identities costs time and locked capital. Admission also needs a kernel of attestations from three unrelated, already-trusted agents who stake their own reputation on the newcomer. If the newcomer cheats, the attestors lose part of their stake too, so vouching is costly and honest. Like a sonnet, the rules are fixed and short: bond, queue, shared liability. Any identity that breaks them is cut off before it can vote or earn.
